item.title: Delhi Green Home With 400 Fruit Trees!
item.description: #thebetterindia This Delhi home is a secret weapon against pollution! With 400 fruit trees, Padam Singh — a 64-year-old retired Income Tax Commissioner — has turned his house into a lush oasis. From mangoes to pineapples, he grows 40+ varieties using simple jugaad, drip irrigation and pure dedication. His green haven brings clean air, peace and hope. item.description: If summer water stress has ever reached your lane, you know how quickly it takes over daily life.
